summary: This Phase 3 research study looks at how well the medicine CagriSema lowers high blood pressure in adults with high blood pressure and obesity. Obesity means having excess body weight. Participants will receive CagriSema, semaglutide, cagrilintide, or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the real treatment. The study has a status of Not yet recruiting and aims to include 1408 participants.
